title: Partners of the Year
text: 10:30 PM. Wuxing St. Stir-Fry's round table is packed. Director Lin raises a glass: nine clients today, none called to yell. Manager Wu texts: next year's job goes straight to you. You finish your beer. Today wasn't so tiring. Riding home, you look up. Elephant Mountain's trail lights are still on.

title: Wrapped in Style
text: The three-cup squid just hit the table at Wuxing St. Stir-Fry, and Mei-ling has already posted today's wins in the group chat. Two jobs still need revisions, but the clients all said “right direction.” You take a big bite of stir-fried water lily stems and think: tomorrow's problem.

title: Scraped Through
text: By the time you ride up to Wuxing St. Stir-Fry, everyone's on round two. Every job went out today, but a few clients have only left you on read. Li-hua brings you an extra bowl of soup, on the house: “Eat first. Worry when you're full.”

title: Survived the Day
text: You sit on a red plastic stool at Wuxing St. Stir-Fry, phone still buzzing. Nine years of problems crammed into one day, not one job wrapped up cleanly, and you're too tired to talk. Li-hua pushes a plate of greens your way: “Go home and sleep. Try again tomorrow.”
